name: timezone-correct-scheduling-p4
prompt: how do I schedule a recurring reminder so it fires at the right local wall-clock time even across daylight saving changes

chunks.content: restyled the calendar grid so today's column has a highlighted border
partitioned the events table by month to keep queries fast
every campaign email includes a one-click unsubscribe link
the redesigned settings panel is gated behind a beta flag
the travel page shows departure and arrival times in local airport time and computes the duration accounting for the timezone difference
thousands separators follow the viewer's locale in reports
the meeting invite email lists the start time in three timezones so remote attendees in different regions know when to join
defined an SLO of 99.9 percent availability for the checkout API
the mobile login flow uses PKCE to protect the authorization code
search now tolerates one-character typos via a fuzzy match
the scheduler recomputes the next occurrence by applying the timezone's current daylight-saving offset at run time, so a 9am daily reminder stays at 9am wall-clock even after the clocks shift
when a chosen time lands in a fall-back fold and occurs twice, we pick the first occurrence consistently so the reminder is not delivered twice
for times that fall in a spring-forward gap that does not exist, we roll the firing forward to the next valid instant instead of silently skipping that day's reminder
decided to store each reminder with its IANA timezone id plus the local time the user picked, rather than a fixed UTC instant, so the next firing is recomputed in that zone every time
